title: Joseph Joseph interprets a interprets a Dream Dream
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Genesis 41: Pharaoh dreams of seven fat cows eaten by seven thin cows and seven full heads of grain swallowed by seven thin ones; Joseph says God gives the meaning: seven years of plenty, then seven of famine.

floor.prerequisite: Can retell an Old Testament story in order.
floor.question: Who was healed when he washed in the River Jordan?

representations: two dreams drawn side by side
a time line: 7 years of plenty, 7 years of famine
steps: Joseph says the answer is from God.
Seven years of plenty, then seven of famine.
contexts: a farmer storing maize after a good harvest
a family saving for school fees

board.do: Draw seven fat cows and seven thin cows.
Point at the thin cows eating the fat ones.
Wait for the child to say seven years of famine after seven of plenty.
Draw the time line under the cows.

misconceptions.ask: Who gave the meaning of Pharaoh's dreams, according to Joseph?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 41:16: "I cannot do it, but God will give Pharaoh the answer".

misconceptions.ask: How many years of plenty did the seven fat cows stand for?
misconceptions.repair: Draw the seven fat cows and write a year under each.

misconceptions.ask: What did the seven thin cows eating the fat cows mean?
misconceptions.repair: Draw it: fat cows are plenty, thin cows are famine.

misconceptions.ask: What were Pharaoh's two dreams about (Genesis 41:17-24)?
misconceptions.repair: Draw both dreams side by side and ask the child to say what they share: seven good, seven poor.

checks.question: Who gave Joseph the meaning of the dreams?
What did the seven fat cows stand for?

skills.key_step: The child says that true wisdom begins with the fear of the Lord, meaning honouring and obeying God (Proverbs 1:7; Proverbs 9:10), and that Joseph gave God the credit for the meaning of the dreams.

floor.question: Who did Joseph say gives the meaning of dreams?

representations: a ladder: honour God at the bottom step, wisdom at the top
steps: Say what "fear of the Lord" means: honour and obey God.
Name a wise choice a child can make.
contexts: a class captain who is fair
an elder in the village giving advice
a child who admits a mistake

board.do: Write Proverbs 1:7 and draw a ladder.
Wait for the child to say with honouring the Lord.
Write "honour God" on the bottom step.

listen_for: To be scared of God and hide from him
misconceptions.ask: What does "the fear of the Lord" mean in Proverbs 1:7?
misconceptions.repair: Compare with respecting a good teacher or a loving parent.

listen_for: With being old and having many degrees
misconceptions.ask: Where does true wisdom begin, according to Proverbs 1:7?
misconceptions.repair: Remind the child that Joseph was a young man in prison.

misconceptions.ask: Joseph was praised by Pharaoh. What did Joseph first say?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 41:16 and ask who got the credit.

listen_for: The one with the most marks
misconceptions.ask: Who is wise, according to Proverbs 1:7?
misconceptions.repair: Compare two people: one with top marks who cheats, one who honours God and is fair. Which is wise?

checks.question: What does "the fear of the Lord" mean in Proverbs 1:7?
Joseph was praised. Who did he say gave the answer?
